notes.text: Bug: Defaults to .NET Version When Not Using .NET and Dropdown  in Project Card was Bugged
'Open' Button alongside the 'Uninstall Button' in the Version Card to open the Godot Launcher of that version directly
Reduce Github API Usage by reducing pagination and using the 'per_page' parameter to fetch more results in a single request
Improved the performance of the app by optimizing the code and reducing unnecessary re-renders
(Optional) Github PAT to increase the rate limit for Github API requests
Removed Export/Import Settings from the Advanced Settings as it was risking exporting Github PAT + it's not really needed.
Linux: 'Open Folder' on a project now falls back through gio, nautilus, dolphin, and thunar if xdg-open fails
Linux: 'Open in Terminal' in Git sidebar now tries gnome-terminal, kgx, ptyxis, konsole, xfce4-terminal, and respects the $TERMINAL environment variable
Workspaces now have their own separate installed versions and templates; switching workspaces shows only that workspace's versions and templates, just like projects and categories
Workspace switching now correctly reloads settings, projects, categories, versions, and templates on switch instead of showing stale data
Project card checkbox no longer overlaps with the project title when sorting by anything other than categories
Support button in the titlebar is now wider with a visible label and a colored style; Star on GitHub button moved to its right
Option in Settings → Advanced to disable the Support button in the titlebar
Option in Settings → Advanced to disable the Star on GitHub button in the titlebar
Custom themed scrollbar across the entire app that follows dark/light mode and accent color
Scrollbar no longer hides behind the titlebar when scrolled to the top
Option in Settings → Appearance to disable the scrollbar entirely; scroll still works via keyboard, trackpad, or mouse wheel
